provenance.extraction: Figures and tables read from saved notebook outputs. Training and inference were not rerun for this repository update.
provenance.numeric_precision: Metrics retain rounded values printed by pandas, including scientific notation. They are not the unavailable original full-precision runtime CSV/JSON files; rounded pixel counts must not be used as exact counts.
provenance.threshold_table: Complete saved displayed text is included; pandas abbreviated some of the 27 columns. No missing threshold columns were invented.

configuration.loss: Binary cross-entropy + per-image soft Dice loss

metric_definitions.soft_global_dice: same soft formula after summing over every image and pixel
metric_definitions.global_dice: 2*TP/(2*TP+FP+FN), pooled over all images and pixels
metric_definitions.global_iou: TP/(TP+FP+FN), pooled over all images and pixels
metric_definitions.mean_dice_all: unweighted mean of thresholded per-image Dice over all images
metric_definitions.mean_dice_positive: same per-image Dice, restricted to nonempty ground-truth masks
metric_definitions.mean_iou_all: unweighted mean of thresholded per-image IoU over all images
metric_definitions.positive_subset: defined from ground truth only: sum(y_true) > 0
metric_definitions.thresholded_empty_policy: empty ground truth AND empty prediction: Dice=IoU=1; exactly one is empty: Dice=IoU=0; all-empty ground truth/prediction also gives global Dice=IoU=1
metric_definitions.soft_empty_policy: use the unchanged smooth formula, without thresholding: empty ground truth gives smooth/(sum(probabilities)+smooth); both exactly zero gives 1; small nonzero probabilities are penalized
metric_definitions.undefined_policy: missing positive/empty subsets and undefined precision/recall/specificity are None (JSON null, empty CSV cell), never an invented zero
metric_definitions.threshold_selection: validation only; original grid 0.10 to 0.90 step 0.10; maximize global_dice, then minimize empty_false_positive_rate

limitations: Single recorded training run and a single patient-disjoint test split; no uncertainty interval or external validation is supplied.
Metrics are slice-level or pixel-pooled, not patient-wise or 3D volume-level.
Prediction preview contains four tumor-positive test slices only; empty-slice errors are reported numerically.
Prior V2 and supplied Final runs used TensorFlow 2.20.0 and 2.21.0 respectively; performance changes cannot be attributed solely to code changes.
